mapper.insert: INSERT INTO menu (site_id, parent_id, code, name, url, target, icon, sort_order, depth, path, is_visible, status, metadata) VALUES (#{siteId}, #{parentId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{url}, #{target}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{depth}, #{path}, #{isVisible}, #{status}, #{metadata}::jsonb)
mapper.update: UPDATE menu SET path = #{path}, depth = #{depth}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
